answer: Give every identity a public mirror: a tamper-evident log of all its past work, and let voting weight rise only with a long streak of verified contributions, reaching its zenith after ten consecutive honest epochs. Entry runs through one narrow jetty: a newcomer must complete a supervised probation task whose result is mirrored for all to see. An honest agent does the work once and climbs steadily. An attacker with a thousand fakes must fake a thousand complete ten-epoch histories, each mirrored and checkable, so the flood cost rises linearly with every fake and its profit collapses.
